zh: 先看左圖：階梯函數兩段平線的斜率都是 0，跳躍處沒有斜率；再看右圖：sigmoid 在 x = 0 的切線斜率是 0.25。這張圖說明階梯為什麼不能用梯度。〔功能：1〕
階梯函數斜率處處為 0、跳躍處沒有斜率；sigmoid 在 x = 0 的切線斜率 0.25。
en: First see the left chart: both flat parts of the step have slope 0 and the jump has no slope; then the right chart: the sigmoid has a tangent of slope 0.25 at x = 0. This shows why the step cannot be used with gradients. [Function: 1]
The step has slope 0 everywhere and none at the jump; the sigmoid has a tangent of slope 0.25 at x = 0.

zh: 先看中間三條 sigmoid（a = 0.7、2、8）與虛線階梯，a 越大越貼近階梯；再看右邊的斜率，高峰 a/4 = 0.175、0.5、2 越來越窄。〔功能：1、2〕
a = 0.7、2、8 的 sigmoid 與斜率；斜率高峰 0.175、0.5、2 越來越窄。
en: First see the three sigmoids (a = 0.7, 2, 8) in the middle against the dashed step, the larger a the closer to the step; then the slopes on the right, whose peaks a/4 = 0.175, 0.5, 2 get narrower. [Function: 1, 2]
Sigmoids and slopes for a = 0.7, 2, 8; the slope peaks 0.175, 0.5, 2 get narrower.

before: 接下來的問題：有了斜率
zh: 先看左邊權重標在線旁、偏置寫在單元旁，再順著箭頭看 x → y → o 的三個數字 0.525、0.450、0.471；右邊是逐步的算式，E = 0.140。〔功能：1〕
en: First see the weights beside the lines and the biases beside the units, then follow x → y → o through the three numbers 0.525, 0.450, 0.471; the right side shows the computation, E = 0.140. [Function: 1]
The 2–2–1 network and forward pass: y₁ = 0.525, y₂ = 0.450, o = 0.471, E = 0.140.

zh: 先看 w → v → o → E 的三個箭頭，每段下面是一段斜率：0.525、0.249、−0.529；再看最下面三段相乘的結果 −0.069。〔功能：1、2〕
en: First see the three arrows w → v → o → E with one slope under each: 0.525, 0.249, −0.529; then the product of the three at the bottom, −0.069. [Function: 1, 2]
The chain rule splits the gradient of w(o1) into three slopes: −0.529 × 0.249 × 0.525 = −0.069.

zh: 先看三根長條，各是一個輸出權重的更新量 ηδ × 輸入（+0.0396、+0.0208、+0.0178）；再注意三根都是正的，因為目標 1 比輸出 0.471 大。〔功能：1、2〕
en: First see the three bars, each the update ηδ × input of one output weight (+0.0396, +0.0208, +0.0178); then note all three are positive because the target 1 is above the output 0.471. [Function: 1, 2]
Updates of the three output weights: +0.0396, +0.0208, +0.0178.

zh: 先看紅色虛線，它是誤差從輸出往回走的路徑；再比較兩條路徑上的權重正負，隱藏單元 2 走的是負權重，所以 δ₂ = −0.0131 是負的。〔功能：1〕
en: First see the red dashed lines, the path of the error back from the output; then compare the signs of the weights on the two paths: hidden unit 2 uses a negative weight, so δ₂ = −0.0131 is negative. [Function: 1]
δ passed back along the weights: δₒ = 0.1319, δ₁ = 0.0164, δ₂ = −0.0131.

zh: 先看左邊九個權重的「舊值、輸入、δ、梯度、更新量、新值」；再看右邊：輸出從 0.4706 走到 0.4857，代價從 0.1401 降到 0.1322。〔功能：1、2〕
en: First see the table of the nine weights with old value, input, δ, gradient, update and new value on the left; then the right: the output goes from 0.4706 to 0.4857 and the cost from 0.1401 to 0.1322. [Function: 1, 2]
The nine-weight update table; output 0.4706 → 0.4857 and cost 0.1401 → 0.1322.

zh: 先看長條，是九個權重的 −δ × 輸入（也就是梯度）；再看圓點，是用差分算出的斜率。兩者重合，最大只差約 3.8×10⁻¹¹，表示反向傳播的算式正確。〔功能：2〕
九個權重的 −δ × 輸入與中心差分斜率重合，最大差距約 3.8×10⁻¹¹。
en: First see the bars, which are −δ × input (the gradient) of the nine weights; then the dots, the slopes from differences. They coincide, differing by at most about 3.8×10⁻¹¹, so the backpropagation formulas are right. [Function: 2]
−δ × input and the central-difference slopes of the nine weights coincide, with a largest gap of about 3.8×10⁻¹¹.

zh: 先看對數座標的三根長條，a 越大，x = 3 處的斜率越小：0.068、0.0049、3×10⁻¹⁰，差約 8 個數量級；右邊說明 δ 乘上幾乎是 0 的斜率，權重幾乎不動。〔功能：2〕
en: First see the three log-scale bars: the larger a, the smaller the slope at x = 3: 0.068, 0.0049, 3×10⁻¹⁰, about 8 orders of magnitude; the right explains that δ times an almost-zero slope barely moves the weights. [Function: 2]
The left is Q1: e = −0.471 and δ = −0.1173; the right is Q2: bias −0.0352, w₁ −0.0185, w₂ −0.0158, all moving down, each with its check. [Function: 1, 2]
Two exercises with worked answers: δ = −0.1173; updates −0.0352, −0.0185, −0.0158.
